title: Wonderful Words of Life
alsoKnownAs: Sing Them Over Again to Me
description: Wonderful Words of Life in Tonic Solfa to WORDS OF LIFE: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses and the refrain, and a piano.
about: Philip P. Bliss wrote both the words and the tune; the song was published in 1874.
underlay: Sing them o-ver a-gain to me, Won-der-ful words of life_; Let me more of their beau-ty see, Won-der-ful words of life. Words of life and_ beau-ty Teach me faith and_ du-ty; Beau-ti-ful words, won-der-ful words, Won-der-ful words of life__; Beau-ti-ful words, won-der-ful words, Won-der-ful words of life.

lines: Sing them over again to me,
Let me more of their beauty see,
Christ, the blessed One, gives to all
Sinner, list to the loving call,
Offer pardon and peace to all,
